brief.prompt: Create a small funny story of a cat becoming president of the US.

requirements.description: A recognizable cat is the protagonist; maintain its identity across shots.
Show the cat campaigning for president, with a visible campaign action.
Show the cat winning the election, not just a presidential title.
Establish the US presidency through the office, flags and presidential role.
Deliver visual jokes and a payoff caused by the cat's behavior.

assets.description: Original orange tabby: triangular pink ears, whiskers, vertical pupils, cream muzzle, articulated paws and curled tail.
The same orange tabby curled into a sleeping loaf; ears, whiskers, stripes and closed eyes remain identifiable.

shots.purpose: An empty bowl and expensive milk give Mittens a political ambition.

nodes.text: Mittens had one policy: more milk.

shots.purpose: Mittens waves from a campaign podium, promising more naps and less work.
A results board declares Mittens the winner; the defeated rival is a vacuum cleaner.

nodes.text: Even the dog voted for him.

shots.purpose: In the US presidential office, Mittens paw-stamps an executive order making naps mandatory.

nodes.text: His first order was signed... with a paw.

shots.purpose: Mittens immediately obeys his own order and sleeps on the presidential desk at 10:01 AM.

nodes.text: He took office. Then he took a nap.

beats.description: Ears, whiskers, pupils, paws and tail identify a tabby inspecting its empty bowl.
Cat waves at a campaign podium with its nap platform.
Mittens wins 99% against a vacuum cleaner and raises both paws.
US flags, office and desk establish presidency; a paw mark signs the nap order.
The same cat sleeps on the presidential desk beneath drifting Zs.
